dimension-tabs.title: Dimension tabs
dimension-tabs.text: State shows the US map; Grade shows the A–G staircase; other dimensions show one tile per segment. Every tab uses the same primary test window: {primary_window}, {n_oot} resolved loans.
dimension-tabs.try: Switch to Grade and click the step with the highest expected loss.

map.title: Segment map
map.text: State uses the US map; Grade uses the staircase; other dimensions use tiles. Click or tap a segment to link it to the ranked list and summary. Use the small-state buttons for compact states.
map.try: Select California and compare its 95% interval with a small state.

ranked-list.title: Ranked segments
ranked-list.text: A row and its map shape or staircase step stay linked, so clicking either selects the same segment.
ranked-list.try: Click the top row, then use the browser Back button.

filter.title: Filter segments
filter.text: Type part of a state, grade, purpose, vintage, term or home-ownership label. The filter only hides rows; it does not change the selected segment or the portfolio totals.
filter.try: Type California, then clear the box.

kpi-ci.title: 95% confidence interval
kpi-ci.text: The Wilson interval shows the sampling uncertainty around the observed default rate. A small segment can have a wide interval even when its point estimate looks dramatic.
kpi-ci.try: Select a small state and compare its interval with the portfolio in Selection.

model-check.title: Model check
model-check.text: Compares the model's predicted PD with the observed default of this segment. Outside the interval means the model is miscalibrated here.
model-check.try: Find a segment where predicted PD sits outside the interval.

risk-rho.title: Asset correlation (ρ)
risk-rho.text: ρ controls how much loans move together through the systematic factor. A higher ρ makes defaults cluster in bad years and pushes the tail of the loss distribution up.
risk-rho.try: Drag ρ from its base case toward the right and watch VaR 99.9%.

risk-pd.title: PD stress
risk-pd.text: This multiplies every loan's probability of default by the chosen factor before simulation. It answers “what if defaults are more frequent than the calibrated baseline?” It is a stress, not a forecast.
risk-pd.try: Set PD stress to a higher multiplier and compare ES 99.9%.

risk-lgd.title: LGD stress
risk-lgd.text: This multiplies loss given default before simulation. It asks what happens if recoveries are worse than the portfolio-level assumption.
risk-lgd.try: Raise both PD and LGD stress and watch the loss histogram shift right.

play-rho.title: Play the rho sweep
play-rho.text: The sweep moves ρ through the precomputed grid so you can see the tail respond. It does not re-simulate in the browser.
play-rho.try: Start the sweep, then pause it on a high-ρ point.

gauge.title: VaR gauge
gauge.text: The gauge puts the current VaR 99.9% on a fixed 0–60% loss scale. It is a visual reference, not a regulatory limit or an appetite statement.
gauge.try: Use the sliders to pick a high-stress scenario and watch the needle.

loss-histogram.title: Loss distribution
loss-histogram.text: Each bar counts simulated portfolio losses for the current scenario. The vertical lines mark EL, VaR 99%, VaR 99.9%, ES 99% and ES 99.9%; the legend lists their values so the labels never collide.
loss-histogram.try: Increase LGD stress and see how far the whole distribution moves right.

surface.title: VaR surface
surface.text: The surface shows the selected risk metric across ρ and PD stress on the precomputed grid. The dark marker is the current scenario and the outlined marker is the base case. It does not change the sliders.
surface.try: Rotate the surface to a high-ρ, high-PD corner, then use the sliders and read the histogram.

surface-metric.title: Surface metric
surface-metric.text: All three options use the same simulation grid, so only the displayed metric changes.
surface-metric.try: Compare the shape of EL with the shape of ES 99.9%.

sim-dti.title: Debt-to-income ratio
sim-dti.text: Higher DTI means less room for a new payment; the scorecard contribution reflects that relationship.
sim-dti.try: Move DTI up and watch the point contribution change.

sim-revol_util.title: Credit card utilization
sim-revol_util.text: High utilization is associated with higher observed risk in this project.
sim-revol_util.try: Compare low and high utilization presets.

sim-inq_last_6mths.title: Credit inquiries
sim-inq_last_6mths.text: More inquiries are associated with higher risk here.
sim-inq_last_6mths.try: Set inquiries to the highest bin and read the score.

sim-purpose.title: Loan purpose
sim-purpose.text: Categories are grouped into the published scorecard bins, with rare categories combined under “Other / rare categories.”
sim-purpose.try: Compare Debt consolidation with Credit card.

sim-installment_to_income.title: Monthly payment vs income
sim-installment_to_income.text: The monthly loan payment as a share of monthly income. The project computes it as installment × 12 ÷ annual income, which is the same ratio on a monthly basis.
sim-installment_to_income.try: Raise the payment share and watch the score fall.

sim-presets.title: Applicant presets
sim-presets.text: Typical picks the most common test-window bin; lower-risk picks the highest-points bin; higher-risk picks the lowest-points bin.
sim-presets.try: Load Lower-risk, then Higher-risk, and compare the PD.

cutoff-slider.title: Score cutoff
cutoff-slider.text: Applicants at or above this score are approved. Moving the cutoff trades approval volume against the bad rate among approved loans. The published KS cutoff is marked separately.
cutoff-slider.try: Find the approximate cutoff where the bad rate rises sharply.

state-map.title: US state map
state-map.text: Hovering shows only the state name; hatched states cannot be selected, and the Selection block holds the numbers.
state-map.try: Select California and read its observed default, interval and rank in Selection.

grade-staircase.title: Grade risk staircase
grade-staircase.text: Step height and color show observed default by grade. Hovering shows only the grade; clicking or tapping a step links it to the ranked list and Selection.
grade-staircase.try: Compare grade A with grade F, then read the Selection block.

map-zoom.title: Map zoom
map-zoom.text: Ctrl + scroll or pinch zooms between 1x and 6x. Drag to pan, double-click to zoom in, or use the +, − and reset buttons. With the map focused, + / − / 0 also work. Zoom resets when you leave State.
map-zoom.try: Zoom into the northeast and select a small state.

small-states.title: Small states
small-states.text: The compact strip repeats states that are too small to read reliably on the map. Hovering shows the full name; clicking selects the same segment as its map shape.
small-states.try: Use the strip to select Rhode Island, then read its numbers in Selection.

masked-states.title: Masked states
masked-states.text: Hatching marks segments with fewer than {min_n} loans. Their rates are too noisy to rank, so they are not selectable and do not receive a fill color. Hovering or focusing shows only the state name; the Selection block holds the numbers.
masked-states.try: Hover Iowa for its name, then select California to compare the figures in Selection.

el-note.title: Expected loss ranking
el-note.text: Expected loss is roughly PD x the portfolio LGD ({lgd}), so it ranks segments almost like Predicted PD.
el-note.try: Switch between Expected loss and Predicted PD and compare the order.
